honing_confound: Peacemaker provides stance-specific bonuses (Shotgun +25% Crit, Rifle +20% damage, etc.) that compound with gear stats. At T4, the shotgun close-range crit multiplier is particularly significant. Tier standing reflects mastery-dependent ceiling.

delivery.evidence: Gunslinger (female triple-weapon counterpart to Deadeye) uses: Shotgun (close range, high damage), Dual Pistols (medium range, rapid fire), Rifle (long range, precision). Peacemaker uses all three weapon stances fluidly.

footprint.evidence: Same as Deadeye Enhanced Weapon — footprint varies by active weapon stance. Shotgun = small cone; Pistol = small single-target; Rifle = line/point.

geo_text: Peacemaker Gunslinger is the master-of-all-weapons identity. Fluid stance switching between shotgun (close-range burst), dual pistols (medium rapid fire), and rifle (long-range precision). Each stance has a Peacemaker bonus: Shotgun +25% Crit in front, Pistol stance has enhanced cooldowns, Rifle +20% outgoing damage. The identity is managing optimal stance for each situation.

control.evidence: Some Gunslinger skills have knockback on impact. No CC identity.

defense.evidence: Gunslinger is the most mobile Gunner class — excellent dodging and repositioning capability. Outmaneuvers all other Gunners in mobility.

economy.resource_verbatim: Weapon Charge (Heat Haze gauge for rifle ready state) + stance-specific gauges
economy.builder_source: Different stances fill different gauges. Shotgun and pistol skills fill Rifle stance gauge. Rifle stance has limited but powerful skills.
economy.plain_text: STANCE ECONOMY: Peacemaker uses all three weapon stances. Each stance uses a subset of skills. Transitions between stances are managed by the player. PEACEMAKER BONUSES per stance: Shotgun (+25% Crit Rate in front) → close-range burst; Pistol (cooldown enhancements) → medium sustained; Rifle (+20% damage) → long-range precision. Identity: always use the optimal stance for the current engagement range and rotation state.

element.evidence: Same as Deadeye. Three weapon types, all Physical gunfire.

movement.evidence: Highest mobility in the Gunner archetype. Excellent repositioning between stance changes. Dodge rolls between skills.

attr.evidence: Triple weapon range profile. Must close to shotgun range for burst; can engage at any distance with pistol/rifle.

tempo.evidence: Shotgun burst at close range provides the primary burst moment. Peacemaker manages stance cycling to maximize shotgun burst windows.

amp.value: Shotgun +25% Crit Rate in front; Pistol enhanced cooldowns; Rifle +20% damage
amp.evidence: Training knowledge — specific Peacemaker bonus values. Confirmed stance bonuses exist per multiple sources.

commitment.evidence: Shotgun skills require close positioning and have charge animations. Rifle skills are precision charges. Pistol skills are faster.

mechanics_notes: 1) Gunslinger is generally considered SUPERIOR to Deadeye in current LA meta (2024-2026) — same triple-weapon archetype but better damage tuning and slightly more mobility. Peacemaker Gunslinger is the benchmark for the triple-weapon identity. 2) GENDER NOTE: Gunslinger (female) vs Deadeye (male) share the same class concept in LA (unusual for an MMO to have gendered versions of the same archetype). The female version is consistently higher-tier in community rankings. 3) Stance management at high level (Peacemaker) requires optimization of which skills to use in which stance for maximum output. This is among LA's highest APM/decision demands. 4) The Shotgun +25% Crit frontally (not back-attack like Deadeye) gives Gunslinger a positional advantage — frontal engagement at shotgun range rather than rear-only like Deadeye's back-attack requirement.
stabilization_patch: Peacemaker has been dominant Gunslinger identity from launch through 2026.
tier_standing_release: S/A-tier at launch (Gunslinger was top DPS at global launch)
tier_standing_current: B-tier (Manillagames January 2026 — Gunslinger listed B). HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: shotgun burst at T4 is competitive but class fell from S-tier early dominance as other classes received buffs; mechanical skill demand remains high.

honing_confound: Time to Hunt's rifle + pistol damage bonus scales with Magic power (gear honing). Tier standing reflects the simplified single-range-mode advantage at T4.

delivery.evidence: Time to Hunt locks to dual pistols and rifle ONLY (shotgun mode locked). Delivery is ranged projectile — pistol rapid fire at medium range, rifle precision shot at long range.

footprint.evidence: Pistol shots are small single-target or small burst. Rifle shots are narrow line/point. No close-range wide-cone shotgun.

geo_text: Time to Hunt Gunslinger removes shotgun mode for simplified two-weapon play. All combat at medium to long range (no close-range shotgun engagement required). Rifle and pistol skills only. The simplification removes positional close-range risk entirely.

defense.evidence: Same high-mobility profile. Possibly slightly better safety than Peacemaker (no forced close-range shotgun windows).

economy.builder_source: Simplified two-stance economy. Pistol and Rifle skills fire on cooldowns.
economy.plain_text: TWO-STANCE SIMPLIFIED ECONOMY: Shotgun locked out. Pistol and Rifle stances only. Time to Hunt identity: pistol and rifle skill damage increased as compensation. Economy simplifies to two weapon modes vs Peacemaker's three — lower APM demand, more consistent safe-range engagement.

movement.evidence: Same high mobility. Medium/long range removes the close-range shotgun dash requirement — can maintain safer distance throughout.

attr.evidence: With shotgun removed, engagement shifts entirely to medium-long range.

range.evidence: Pistol: 5-15m. Rifle: 20-30m. No 0-5m shotgun range required.

tempo.evidence: Time to Hunt is more sustained than Peacemaker (no shotgun close-range burst cycle). Rifle precision shots create micro-burst moments but overall feel is more consistent.

amp.value: Pistol and rifle skill damage increased (Time to Hunt identity bonus vs Peacemaker's per-stance bonuses)
amp.evidence: Training knowledge. Time to Hunt provides compensation bonuses for the locked shotgun mode.

commitment.evidence: Rifle precision shots have charge animations. Pistol skills are faster.

mechanics_notes: 1) Time to Hunt mirrors Pistoleer Deadeye and Control Glaivier: removes the most complex weapon mode (shotgun requires close positioning) for safer sustained output. 2) Time to Hunt has lower CEILING than Peacemaker (shotgun burst is the class's highest-damage window) but is much more beginner-friendly (no close-range positioning required). 3) The Gunslinger pair (Peacemaker = all weapons, Time to Hunt = no shotgun) represents the clearest 'master vs specialist' identity fork — one identity masters all weapons while the other simplifies to two.
stabilization_patch: Time to Hunt is consistently the 'secondary' Gunslinger identity — preferred by beginners or for specific mobile-raid content.
tier_standing_current: B/C-tier. HONING-CONFOUND NOTE: damage bonus from locked-out-shotgun compensation is less tier-dependent than Peacemaker's shotgun crit ceiling.
